senses.gloss:
उह् {c1c} P. (ओहति, उवोह; उहित)
1 To hurt or give pain.
--2 To kill,
destroy; see ऊह्.

ऊह् {vI.v} {c1c} U. (ऊहति-ते, ऊहांचकार-वक्रे,
ऊहितुं, ऊहित)
1 To note, mark,
[]
observe.
--2 To guess, conjecture,
infer; अनुक्तमप्यूहति पंडितो जनः
Pt. 1. 43.
--3 To comprehend, conceive,
perceive, expect; ऊहांचक्रे जयं न च
Bk. 14. 72, 3. 48, 15. 123.
--4 To reason,
deliberate about.
--5 To reckon
upon (with loc.).
--6 To wait for.
--7 To be regarded as. {vII.v}
{c1c} P.
1 To change or modify.
--2
To push, thrust, remove (with
a prep.) --Caus. To cause to
[]
reason, think, infer or conjecture;
Ki. 16. 19.
